result.title: ScIntBench: Physical Interaction Plausibility in 3D Scene Generation
result.summary: Existing evaluations of text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation largely emphasize semantic fidelity and physical validity at rest, leaving interaction-time physical reliability insufficiently assessed. To address this gap, we introduce ScIntBench, a unified benchmark centered on interaction readiness: it executes prescribed manipulation actions (e.g., pushing, opening, and surface probing) in physics simulation and measures task success, capability and progress, post-interaction integrity, and dynamic plausibility. Multi-view semantic and static physical evaluations complement these metrics and help explain interaction outcomes. We systematically evaluate 12 state-of-the-art scene generation systems across 10 room types. Our results reveal that strong semantic and static physical performance does not necessarily translate into interaction readiness: a system with near-perfect static plausibility completes only 11.54% of interactions, 7 of the 12 systems produce scenes that cannot support any interaction, and even the best system succeeds in only 36.92% of prescribed tasks. These findings highlight two fundamental challenges in generating interaction-ready scenes: providing the necessary physical interaction capabilities and ensuring reliable physical behavior under active manipulation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ScIntBench，一个评测文本条件 3D 室内场景「交互可用性」的基准：在物理仿真中执行推动、开门、表面探测等指定操作，按任务成功、交互后完整性、动态合理性等指标系统评测 12 个场景生成系统在 10 类房间上的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 「静态物理合理不等于可交互使用」的评测思路，可能为考察 latent 视觉状态是否真正支撑后续推理与操作提供类比指标，但研究对象是 3D 场景生成，与 VLM 推理距离较远，可供核查。
